newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 1.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
President Jiang Zemin, in new year's message, calls for Taiwan people to offer suggestions on ways to reunify island with China.
An editorial says political and social stability is a priority and urges the people to be of one heart and mind to achieve the nation's economic goals for the new year.
China's steel output in 1996 surpassed 100 million tonnes, ranking it first in the world.
